content:
Alex H: quick heads-up — paging rolled for multiple alerts in eu-west around 09:03 UTC. primary->secondary transfer incoming, leaving a 12m coverage patch if we don't grab it now.
Priya S: copying in context — seeing p95/token latency spike on embeddings-queue (svc:embeddings-proxy) and a cascade of kv-cache evictions. graphs at https://grafana.redwood/internals/d/embeddings.
Maria G: customer-impact check: two paying tenants (AcmeCorp, NovaHealth) reported timeouts for batched embedding jobs. Acme sent a support ticket.
Oncall Bot: INC-4527 created & assigned to "primary-oncall"; severity = P1; bridge: https://zoom.redwood/BR-4527.
Jordan K: I'm taking primary for the next 30m. @Priya S you good to be secondary? If not I can request backup.
Priya S: I can be secondary for now. leaving my phone awake.
Alex H: handoff notes: active alerts = embeddings-p95 > 1200ms (eu-west), kv-cache-eviction-rate > 30/s, queue-length > 5000. mitigation in progress: rolling up a small dedicated pool (ded-emb-02) + temporary routing to ded-emb-01.
Maria G: mitigation steps already kicked off by ops-bot: scaling ded pool to +2 instances. still seeing errors downstream: some workers hit 429 from rate-limiter.
Jordan K: 429s are from the frontend rate-limiter rule we added last week. for emergency, reduce limiter threshold:
```
# reduce frontend limiter for embeddings
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/emb-rateless -- /bin/sh -c "curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/config -d '{\"burst\":1000,\"rate\":2000}'"
```
Alex H: runbook pointer: follow "Embedding latency surge" section in runbook V3 — /runbooks/embeddings_latency_v3.md (see steps 2-5 for safe throttles & warmup). runbook-bot, please paste the checklist.
runbook-bot: Checklist: 1) Verify mem pressure on kv nodes 2) Scale ded pools 3) Reduce frontend limiter 4) Enable routing fallback -> small-quant model 5) Notify customers & support.
Priya S: I'm starting the KV prewarm script on cache-nodes-eu: `/opt/tools/kv_preload --target=0.6 --concurrency=6` — this should reduce miss storm in ~5-8m.
Jordan K: Confirmed ded-emb-02 boot succeeded, but health-checks show degraded init latency (likely cold weights). setting warmup replica-count=2.
Maria G: temporary routing fallback plan: route 30% of traffic to quantized-gnn-sm model (smaller memory) — this reduces accuracy for a subset but preserves throughput. patch applied by ops-bot.
Alex H: Customer comms: Maria, can you draft a short status message for AcmeCorp & NovaHealth? mention temporary throttling + mitigation steps. include ETA ~30-45m.
Maria G: Drafted and sent via support. Acme replied: "please prioritize Acme batch queue — they have overnight run." escalated to biz-ops.
Jordan K: Monitoring: keep an eye on these panels: embeddings->p95, kv-cache->evictions, queue->length, ded-pool->util. alert if p95 > 900ms or evictions > 15/s after mitigations.
Alex H: if we see sustained errors after 20m, fallback to full-route -> small-quant model (50/50) and open emergency config revert for the canary.
Priya S: Logging note: I captured recent worker logs — snippet:
```
2026-03-15T09:02:11Z worker-7 ERROR kv miss spike: key_batch=1024, miss_rate=0.87
2026-03-15T09:02:12Z worker-7 WARN embed queue length 5243
```
Oncall Bot: Paging policy engaged: floor escalation to oncall-leads in 18m if not resolved.
Alex H: coverage gap: I will be offline 09:40–10:05 UTC for a short call. Jordan will be primary after 09:40. Priya please escalate to oncall-leads if you need help during that window.
Priya S: noted. I'll keep bridge open. setting pager escalation window +20m.
Maria G: Current state summary for next handoff: primary = Jordan K; secondary = Priya S; active alerts = embeddings-p95 / kv-evictions / queue-length; mitigations = ded-pool scale, kv prewarm, reduce limiter, routing fallback to small-quant; customer impact = AcmeCorp & NovaHealth experiencing delays (support ticket raised).
Jordan K: I'll own next 2h. next steps: monitor graphs, watch for 429 reduction, prepare rollback plan for routing fallback. leaving my phone. :thumbsup:
Alex H: thanks all — leaving notes in thread and adding a short log to incident doc INC-4527. if anything critical, @channel the bridge.
ops-bot: ded pool scaled to +2 instances (ded-emb-02 & ded-emb-03), warmup jobs started.
Maria G: closing loop: Acme acknowledged ETA 30m and put their non-blocking jobs to low-priority.
Priya S: will update last_message_ts and file brief postmortem if incident persists past 4 hours.
Jordan K: logging final checkpoint before handoff: p95=680ms, evictions=8/s, queue-length=2100. holding on to primary"
